**Event:** Invited talk for the Bilkent University Psychology Community\
**Location:** Bilkent University, Ankara, Turkey

## Context

An introduction to the two-system view of human motivation: what implicit and explicit
motives are, how they are measured, why they so often diverge within the same person, and
what that divergence predicts for behavior and wellbeing at work.
